subject: Re: Label-bias status: decisions before the sweep week
body:
Team,

Locking decisions before next week's validation sweep so nothing changes mid-flight.

1) Weight-cap option: approved, ship it in the stage API with the warning in the report artifact. Rosa's imbalance finding is exactly the kind of thing the trust portfolio exists to catch — I'd rather ship a capped, explained method than an uncapped surprising one. The one-week slip is absorbed; pilots start Jul 1 instead of Jun 24.

2) Sweep config freezes Friday: all model families, both fairness notions in the pilot scope (demographic parity, equalized odds), with/without re-weighting, capped and uncapped. Anything not in Friday's config waits for Q3.

3) Kofi — cc'ing you because the report artifact surfaces per-group statistics; want your read on whether that needs privacy review before pilot teams see it. The 2-3 week SLA means we need your answer routed this week.

Decision memo drafts right after sweep results land.

Ximena
